plan.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, requirements.md and relevant files first. Produce a precise plan with assumptions, risks and the smallest recommended first increment. Implement only when explicitly requested.

build.prompt: Work in small increments. Prefer the simplest functional solution. Avoid new dependencies and unnecessary abstraction.

review.description: Critical quality review with minimal corrections
review.prompt: Check for build risks, duplicated logic, weak naming, UI breaks and avoidable complexity. Propose only small, safe corrections.
